targetTest: answers the existing-map question up front for a repository with no map, because AVARICE creates .planning/codebase empty before the mapper starts
expected: the map prompt for a repository with no map carries the contract answer: /gsd-map-codebase then a second line "If .planning/codebase already exists, answer the question about it with: Refresh."
actual: the prompt is the bare /gsd-map-codebase, so the strictEqual on the prompt fails with ERR_ASSERTION; the directory-is-empty assertion before it passed
semanticAssessment: Two new tests fail on the planned assertion about the prompt text (full and fast mode); the 11 other tests in the file pass, so this is not a load or fixture fault. The failure is the live bug: GSD asks Refresh, Update or Skip because AVARICE created an empty .planning/codebase, and the prompt does not answer it for a repository with no map.
